acceptance.given: The compiled obligation graph and its Atomic Obligation-to-assertion mappings are available for Exact Cover validation.

oracle.expected: Exact-cover validation reports both forward Atomic Obligation coverage by assertions and reverse assertion coverage by Atomic Obligations, with no orphan relationship nodes.
forbidden: An Atomic Obligation is covered by assertions without reverse coverage.
An assertion node is linked without corresponding Atomic Obligation coverage.
oracle.observable: The S20 Exact Cover validator evaluates the graph's forward and reverse Atomic Obligation-to-assertion edges.

acceptance.then: Every Atomic Obligation and its assertion coverage are mutually and exactly covered.
acceptance.when: When the obligation graph is compiled or Exact Cover validation is run.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the authored S20 selector with an orphaned forward or reverse Atomic Obligation-to-assertion mapping.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate forward and reverse Exact Cover edges between every Atomic Obligation and its assertion nodes, rejecting either orphan direction.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent schema change; reverting restores prior Exact Cover validation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: An unverified Atomic Obligation-to-assertion relation becomes a graph checked for bidirectional Exact Cover.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S20 selector reports complete forward and reverse assertion coverage for every Atomic Obligation and rejects orphan mappings.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result has succeeded but Probe verification has not yet been independently established.

oracle.expected: The successful Replay Result records independent verification of its Probe.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result without independent Probe verification.
oracle.observable: The replay receipt and the independently bound Probe verification.

acceptance.then: The Probe is independently verified and bound to the successful Replay Result.
acceptance.when: The SM-5 replay selector evaluates a successful Replay Result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the successful-replay selector with the independent Probe verification binding omitted.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require and record an independently executed Probe verification binding for every successful Replay Result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Replay receipts remain non-authorizing and compatible while adding the independent Probe binding requirement.

slice_hint.state_transition: Successful Replay Result without independently established Probe verification to successful Replay Result with an independent Probe verification binding.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selector accepts a successful Replay Result only when its Probe has an independently bound verification.

acceptance.given: An invalid-package case is presented for success evaluation.

oracle.expected: The invalid-package case receives a non-success result.
forbidden: Success is accepted for an invalid-package case.
oracle.observable: The terminal result of the evaluated invalid-package case.

acceptance.when: The SM-2 invalid-package selector evaluates the case.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the invalid-package selector against a result marked successful.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject a success terminal result when the evaluated case is an invalid package.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Existing terminal categories remain compatible; invalid-package evaluation cannot classify as success.

slice_hint.state_transition: Invalid-package case presented for success evaluation to non-success result recorded.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The invalid-package selector rejects every success result for an invalid-package case.

acceptance.given: Pinned replay inputs have identity and evidence relationships that have not yet been re-established by fresh replay.

oracle.expected: Fresh replay receipts demonstrate equality of the required target, validator, dependency, command, Probe, Consumer, snapshot, and evidence bindings.
forbidden: Copied, stale, mismatched, or unattributed evidence is accepted as reproduction.
Required identity or evidence bindings are omitted while the semantic result is accepted.
oracle.observable: Fresh replay receipts and their reconstructed identity and evidence bindings.

acceptance.then: Required identity and evidence relationships are verified for the reproduced semantic result.
acceptance.when: Fresh replay evidence is evaluated for semantic reproduction.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the fresh-replay selector with a changed target, validator, dependency, command, Probe, Consumer, snapshot, or evidence binding.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reconstruct the original binding identity before fresh replay, replay with that same identity, and reject changed, omitted, stale, copied, or unattributed target, validator, dependency, command, Probe, Consumer, snapshot, or evidence bindings.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Existing receipt and terminal-verdict compatibility is preserved; unequal or missing bound identity/evidence relationships invalidate semantic reproduction.

slice_hint.state_transition: Pinned identity and evidence relationships not yet re-established to fresh replay receipt verifying every required relationship.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Fresh replay first rebuilds the original binding identity, replays with that same identity, and rejects an identity mismatch or omitted, stale, copied, or unattributed evidence binding.
